propositions: 23 call sites in test_concurrency_regression.py use _expire_sync_marker + _engine_run(..., 'list') pairs to establish fixture preconditions via incidental side effects, but the best-effort ensure_fresh read path silently swallows failures under CI load, causing setup flakes with signature 'AssertionError: clones do not share a base'
8 of the 23 sites are load-bearing fixture preconditions where one clone is strictly behind the peer and a sync failure produces a misleading or absent test failure

15 of the 23 sites characterize reconvergence through the production read path itself, so the assertion that follows IS the convergence claim and converting them to raw git would delete the invariant they exist to prove
The 8 Kind-P precondition sites must be converted from _engine_run(..., 'list') to the deterministic _sync_from_origin helper (checked fetch + ff-only merge) to eliminate the flake mechanism
The 15 Kind-R read-side sync sites require a named helper _reconverge_by_read_sync to encapsulate the expire+list idiom and document why the best-effort path is deliberate there
Tests must pass with REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off after conversion, proving that each converted precondition still lands when the production read path is disabled
